title: Figure 6: Cloaking Shell – 2D ray diagram and 3D ray-traced cloak
description: Two-part figure. Panel A is a 2D cross-section of a spherical cloak, a red core of radius R1 inside a blue shell of radius R2, with parallel light rays bending smoothly around the core. Panel B is a 3D color rendering of a cutaway cloaking sphere with ray paths wrapping around the hidden interior. The caption reads "Figure 6. Cloaking Shell" in a section titled "Cloaking."
